text:
Kait: Quick thread 1-pager bench narrative for webinar + inbound lead magnet. Need: one bold hero, 3 micro-charts that non-tech PMs get, and two CTAs. Keep words tight.

Omar: Agreed. My recommended arc: 1) hero claim that ties latency tail to product trust, 2) latency mini-panel (median/p95/p99) showing where tail matters, 3) cost waterfall showing savings from batching/quant/cache, 4) recommended config by buyer persona.

Linh: Data ask: CSV with columns: model,deploy_mode,quant,seq_bucket,median_ms,p95_ms,p99_ms,cost_per_1k_usd,cache_hit_rate,batch_profile. Prompt mix: 70/20/10 short/medium/long. Also include a tiny slice for real-time vs async traffic.

Priya: Visuals: use 3-up horizontal layout: latency violin (compact), stacked waterfall, persona micro-table. Captions: 6-10 words each. Include one inset: cache impact at 0/30/60% hits.

Kait: Timeline: Priya hero + 2 alternates by Mon 10am. Omar CSV + sample JSON by Mon 2pm. Linh mockups Wed AM. I'll assemble Wed PM.

ChartBot: Schema validation preview OK. Note: rows with missing cache_hit_rate set to 0. Automated tip: include batch_profile values: none, burst, steady.

Linh: Hero draft options (ultra-short):
- Option 1: "Tame the tail. Protect product trust."
- Option 2: "Predictable latency. Predictable bills."
- Option 3: "Lower tail latency. Lower churn."
Which resonates?

Omar: I like 1 for product teams, 2 for finance-facing slide. Use 3 for social.

Kait: For CTAs, try: 1) "Run your prompts in BenchLab" -> runs a quick free slice; 2) "Book a sizing call" -> dedicated path. Keep the inbound tag: bench-webinar-1719009999.

Linh: Small reproducibility note for appendix (pseudo):
```
# rough per-1k token cost estimate
sec_per_1k = 0.76
gpu_rate = 2.9  # $/gpu-hour
cost_usd = (sec_per_1k / 3600.0) * gpu_rate
print(cost_usd)
```

Priya: I'll write 3 slide captions and a 1-paragraph blog lead after hero picks. Dropping drafts to drive/marketing/bench-1719009999/.

BenchLabBot: BenchLab quick-run available: /internal/benchlab/run?tag=1719009999. Note: expected upload of CSV to s3://bench-exports/2026/marketing/1719009999.csv.

Kait: Great. If anyone hits data gaps, flag here. Will do a final stitch Thurs AM and send to ops. :rocket:
